newsitem.title: CHINA: HK's China Merchants in $373.5 mln China road deal.
newsitem.headline: HK's China Merchants in $373.5 mln China road deal.

text.p: Hong Kong-based China Merchants Group has signed a contract to spend 3.1 billion yuan ($373.5 million) to buy operating rights for 60 percent of an expressway in eastern China, the Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.
China Merchants had signed a draft contract with the Public Security Bureau in the eastern province of Shandong to operate the Jinan-Qingdao expressway on cooperative terms, Xinhua said.
The two sides would set up a cooperative venture to jointly run the highway, which was built with financing from the Public Security Bureau, for 24 years, the agency said.
Shandong authorities were also looking for foreign partners to build expressways between Jinan and Tai'an and from Weifang to Laiyang, it said, but gave no further details.

Xinhua did not say what arm of China Merchants had signed the deal, but the group has several companies listed in Hong Kong, including China Merchants China Direct Investments Ltd and China Merchants Holdings (International) Co Ltd.
